finding: Selecting a result clears query/open/index but retains results; ArrowDown has no query-length guard. On the persistent header, empty input can open hidden stale selection, and Enter can navigate it without a rendered listbox. Closed/short-input aria-describedby also references absent status content.
proposed_fix: Clear retained results at selection; enforce minimum query length before keyboard navigation/selection; reference only rendered status IDs.
regression_plan: Real GlobalSearch: query and choose result, refocus empty input after router navigation, press ArrowDown/Enter and assert no additional push/active descendant; verify normal selection/retry/abort retained.
limits: No test executed in frozen read-only window.

finding: Bell declares aria-modal but implements only document Tab/Escape wrapping; no focusin containment or inert background. GlobalSearch header CtrlK handler can focus its background input while bell remains open.
proposed_fix: Reuse existing shared modal keyboard/isolation boundary, preserving click-outside closure, trigger focus return and scroll/popover geometry; split501-line owner into cohesive controller/presentation modules.
regression_plan: Actual Header bell+search: open bell, CtrlK/background focus attempt stays contained or deliberately closes bell; Tab/ShiftTab/Escape and nested dialog behavior remain; mobile bounded scrolling.
limits: Source/control-flow proof; no browser/unit execution in read-only window.

finding: Remaining vanilla useMutation calls do not capture the initiating actor at actual mutate invocation; new GC/MCP proof demonstrates why later private HTTP capture alone cannot cover queued setup. Here markAllRead could affect a replacement actor, tracker mark/export may target stale intent.
proposed_fix: First reproduce these actual hooks with deferred global/local setup; adopt reviewed invocation envelope and explicit expected-owner transport config where proven. Preserve tracker idempotent mark/undo/selection count semantics.
limits: Do not report as executed/validated in this subtree; no new tests run.

finding: Initial stats error displays an error banner together with zero summary values and No recent passport intake, conflating unavailable data with an empty successful response.
proposed_fix: Represent unavailable initial aggregates/activity explicitly while keeping last-known data on refetch errors.
regression_plan: Initial failure shows unavailable states and recoverable retry; successful empty0 remains valid; background failure retains last confirmed numbers.

finding: Busy/pending state has no synchronous admission guard, allowing same-turn repeated mark/preview/apply calls. regression_plan: Double invocation before rerender and delayed preview disposal; prove backend/request counts and actual route reuse before narrow guard/remount fix.
